assets.title: Sidecut Alpine Ski Pair
assets.description: One original low-poly alpine ski pair counted as one static prop. Two long continuous closed boards have genuine wide shovels, narrow waists, flared tails, variable thickness, upturned tapered tips and gently lifted tail ends. Each ski has separate mounted toe and heel rail plates, a shaped toe housing with two solid retaining wings, a low toe sole pad, a tall heel housing, forward heel clamp, heel sole pad, fixed release lever, pivot and two bent raised brake arms. The measured empty space between the bindings is a visual boot bay, not a fit or release specification. Teal tops, dark bases, pale steel sidewalls and cream inlaid geometric marks use four constant solid PBR materials. Named closed editable meshes, actual finite flat sole support and connected binding components; source Z up, metres, ground-centre origin, tips -Y. One paired product, not two new models; no boots, poles, stand or external textures. Static artistic game visual only: no skiing, turning, snow interaction, binding release, wearable fit, brake operation, load or sports-safety certification.
